recentNews.title: MEGL Enters into Strategic Cooperation with Singapore's SIN HOPEWAY for USD 500 Million Timber Trade

raw.title: MEGL Enters into Strategic Cooperation with Singapore's SIN HOPEWAY for USD 500 Million Timber Trade
raw.text: Hong Kong, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Magic Empire Global Limited (“MEGL” or the “Company”) today announced that on October 22, 2026, it entered into a letter of intent (the “Letter of Intent”) with Singapore-based commodity trading enterprise SIN HOPEWAY PTE. LTD., for a five year strategic cooperation to develop an international timber import and export supply chain business, commencing from the date of the Letter of Intent. During the five-year cooperation period, the Company, having completed its strategic industrial upgrade, shall supply SIN HOPEWAY PTE. LTD. with raw timber materials. The cumulative target trade volume between the parties shall be US$500 million.
